card.name: Linking words before a named drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, or, of, for, received, including) that sit right before a specific drug name, mostly ACE inhibitors and statins, or placebo, in label text on trials and dosing.

modes.label: Link before comparator
modes.description: The word "or", "for" or "received" comes just before placebo or a drug in a trial comparison.
modes.example: randomized them to lisinopril<< or>> placebo on a background of losartan

modes.label: Link before statin or ACE drug
modes.description: "of", "to" or "including" comes right before a named statin or ACE-inhibitor product.
modes.example: patients unable to achieve their LDL-C goal utilizing the 40-mg dose<< of>> simvastatin tablets USP should

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a name or capitalized term next, though the listed tokens are mostly unhelpful.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a blood pressure or cholesterol drug name is expected.
